title: Treat content: null as empty string on the workers-ai route
description:
Surfaced by xrz, deliberately not fixed there (behaviour change on a shape nothing currently sends).

stringifyContentParts passes content: null straight through, with a test pinning that behaviour ("that is a tool call, not a prompt"). omp currently sends "" so nothing is broken today. But if any harness sends null, Workers AI answers 400 naming /messages/N/content — which is the EXACT error cloud/sandbox/README.md tells operators means "the deployed factory predates the translation". So a future harness would produce a false diagnosis pointing at a redeploy that cannot help.

One-line fix (treat null as "") plus flipping the pinned test. The reason to do it now rather than when it bites: the misleading-diagnosis cost is paid by whoever hits it, and this session has already spent several cycles on a fix that looked broken because the diagnosis pointed the wrong way.
